command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'known_folder_diag.py'; @'

import ctypes as c, os, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from pywinauto import Desktop
import psutil

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
targets=("Desktop","Documents","Downloads","Pictures","Music","Videos")
print("USERPROFILE",profile,flush=True)
print("PROFILE_CHILDREN",sorted([p.name for p in profile.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]),flush=True)

# Known folder paths
from ctypes import wintypes as w
class GUID(c.Structure):
    _fields_=[("Data1",c.c_uint32),("Data2",c.c_uint16),("Data3",c.c_uint16),("Data4",c.c_ubyte*8)]
def guid(s):
    import uuid
    return GUID.from_buffer_copy(uuid.UUID(s).bytes_le)
ids={
"Desktop":"B4BFCC3A-DB2C-424C-B029-7FE99A87C641",
"Documents":"FDD39AD0-238F-46AF-ADB4-6C85480369C7",
"Downloads":"374DE290-123F-4565-9164-39C4925E467B",
"Pictures":"33E28130-4E1E-4676-835A-98395C3BC3BB",
"Music":"4BD8D571-6D19-48D3-BE97-422220080E43",
"Videos":"18989B1D-99B5-455B-841C-AB7C74E4DDFC",
}
shell32=c.windll.shell32; ole32=c.windll.ole32
shell32.SHGetKnownFolderPath.argtypes=[c.POINTER(GUID),w.DWORD,w.HANDLE,c.POINTER(c.c_wchar_p)]
shell32.SHGetKnownFolderPath.restype=c.c_long
for name,s in ids.items():
    p=c.c_wchar_p()
    hr=shell32.SHGetKnownFolderPath(c.byref(guid(s)),0,None,c.byref(p))
    path=p.value if p.value else ""
    if p.value: ole32.CoTaskMemFree(c.cast(p,c.c_void_p))
    print("KNOWN_PATH",name,repr(path),"EXISTS",Path(path).is_dir() if path else False,flush=True)

# isolated settings, but real profile path as content root
owned=ROOT/"logs"/"known-folder-diagnostic"
import shutil
if owned.exists(): shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"appdata").mkdir(); (owned/"temp").mkdir()
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
    "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",encoding="ascii",newline="")
env=os.environ.copy()
env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata"); env["APPDATA"]=str(owned/"appdata")
env["TEMP"]=env["TMP"]=str(owned/"temp")
proc=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
try:
    end=time.monotonic()+20; win=None
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        if len(ws)==1: win=ws[0]; break
        time.sleep(.25)
    if not win: raise RuntimeError("window missing")
    time.sleep(3)
    pane=win.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles")
    items=[]
    for item in pane.descendants():
        try:
            if item.element_info.control_type=="ListItem":
                items.append(item.element_info.name or item.window_text())
        except Exception: pass
    print("LEFTFILES_COUNT",len(items),flush=True)
    for x in items[:80]: print("LEFTFILES_ITEM",repr(x),flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        if 'win' in locals() and win is not None:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(win.handle,0x10,0,0)
            try: proc.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: proc.terminate(); proc.wait(timeout=5)
        else:
            proc.terminate(); proc.wait(timeout=5)
print("DIAG_EXIT",proc.returncode,flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
